title: Psionic shortcuts tested on program members, including children

tellings.quote: There are cheats and some of the cheats that have been experimented with are things that have not fared well for those involved in the program including children

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he once flew a UFO out of a recovery site, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a secret program working with psionics, meaning the use of mental or psychic powers. Barber relays what someone he names told him: that the program tried out "cheats", shortcuts to unlock those powers, and that some of them went badly for the people involved, including children. If true, it would mean a hidden program has been running risky mind experiments on its own members, even kids.
